title: fanoutqa: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old? (cc4e6774f97b0101)

chat_history.content: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?

content.content:
The user asks: "Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?" Need to list heads of state (presidents, monarchs, etc.) of the founding countries of EU, who are older than 80.

Founding countries of EU: The European Union started as European Economic Community (EEC) in 1957 with the Treaty of Rome. The six founding members: Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, West Germany (now Germany). So we need heads of state of these six countries.

Heads of state as of current date (2025-10-31). For each country, identify current head of state (monarch or president) and their age, then list those older than 80.

Let's collect:

- Belgium: King Philippe (born 15 April 1960) age 65. Not >80.

- France: President Emmanuel Macron (born 21 Dec 1977) age 47. Not >80. However head of state is president; also there is a ceremonial role? No.

- Italy: President Sergio Mattarella (born 23 July 1941) age 84 (as of 2025). He is >80.

But note: Italy's president term ends in 2025? Actually Mattarella's term was 2022-2029. So yes still president.

- Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri (born 16 April 1955) age 70. Not >80.

- Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander (born 27 April 1967) age 58. Not >80.

- Germany: Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (born 5 Jan 1956) age 69. Not >80.

But also Germany's head of state is President, not Chancellor. So only Italy's president >80.

Check if any other heads: Belgium also has a Prime Minister but not head of state.

Thus answer: Italy's President Sergio Mattarella is older than 80.

But also consider that France also has a President age 47. So only one.

Double-check ages: Sergio Mattarella born 23 July 1941 => 2025-10-31 age 84.

Thus answer: Sergio Mattarella (Italy). Provide maybe note.

Also maybe include other founding members that later expanded? But founding countries only six.

Thus answer.

content:
**Founding members of the EU (the six countries that signed the Treaty of Rome in 1957)**  

| Country | Head of State (2025) | Date of Birth | Age on 31 Oct 2025 | > 80 years? |
|---------|----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------------|
| Belgium | King Philippe | 15 Apr 1960 | 65 | No |
| France | President Emmanuel Macron | 21 Dec 1977 | 47 | No |
| Italy | President **Sergio Mattarella** | 23 Jul 1941 | **84** | **Yes** |
| Luxembourg | Grand Duke Henri | 16 Apr 1955 | 70 | No |
| Netherlands | King Willem‑Alexander | 27 Apr 1967 | 58 | No |
| Germany | President Frank‑Walter Steinmeier | 5 Jan 1956 | 69 | No |

### Answer
Among the heads of state of the EU’s six founding countries, **only Italy’s President Sergio Mattarella** is older than 80 years (84 years old as of 31 October 2025). All the other heads of state are under 80.
